_finding: The outside review (21.11) read 415 tokens beside 90 price readings as 22% coverage. Wherever the site counts tokens it must say what the count is out of: the issuer's list, and of it the minted tokens, the only ones with a price to read. Where the issuer reports no supply the minted count is null, never a guess.

mutations.name: the caption is not on the board
mutations.expect: FAIL the board caption says minted of listed

mutations.name: the caption says listed only, never minted
mutations.find: b.minted != null && b.minted < b.listed ? `${b.minted} minted of ${b.listed} listed · ` :
mutations.expect: FAIL the board caption says minted of listed

mutations.name: an old server's answer prints undefined
mutations.expect: FAIL ...the listed count alone when all are minted
